task.pr_title: fix(http): accept path-only url when socketPath is set (#6611)

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: The config.socketPath is read directly before the existing own('socketPath') guard. We cannot have that, as it would regress some of our guards against prototype pollution.

evidence.thread_resolution: devareddy05: Thanks @jasonsaayman. Good catch. Fixed in e23b20b. I hoisted `const socketPath = own('socketPath')` above the URL parse step and used that value for `urlBase`, so we no longer read `config.socketPath` directly before the own() guard. The synthetic base now only kicks in for an own socketPath, so a polluted prototype can no longer influence URL base selection. I also removed the now duplicate `own('socketPath')` read lower down and reused the single value.
